preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through social engineering/compromise)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function to create new tokens for your own address, effectively printing unlimited tokens and diluting the value for all other holders. Alternatively, set the FeeAddress to your own address and manipulate txFee/burnFee to extract value from every transaction, or blacklist other users to freeze their funds.
